name: Shipping Gateway Per Product for WooCommerce
author: dreamfox

sections.description:
Take complete control over your store’s shipping logic and create a seamless checkout experience with Shipping Gateway Per Product for WooCommerce.

Stop struggling with one-size-fits-all shipping. This plugin gives you powerful, flexible control over which shipping gateways are available—based on products, categories, tags, or even complex combinations.

Whether you’re selling lightweight items, bulky products, or premium goods, you can tailor shipping exactly the way you want.

Learn more about this plugin on our website:
https://dreamfoxmedia.com

Key Features

  • Assign shipping gateways per individual product
  • Set shipping rules per category for bulk management
  • Apply shipping gateways based on product tags
  • Handle multiple products in one cart with advanced logic
  • Choose how to resolve conflicts:
    • Common gateways
    • Cheapest option
    • Most expensive option
    • Or let the customer decide (Premium)
  • Include or exclude specific shipping methods
  • Fully compatible with WooCommerce shipping zones

Why You’ll Love It

  • Save time by managing shipping in bulk (category & tag level)
  • Avoid checkout confusion with smart, automated logic
  • Increase conversions with optimized shipping options
  • Handle complex carts without breaking checkout

Example Use Cases

  • Offer express shipping only for premium products
  • Disable free shipping for heavy or oversized items
  • Automatically select the cheapest shipping for mixed carts
  • Let customers choose their preferred shipping method
  • Apply shipping rules to entire categories or seasonal tags

Upgrade to Premium

Unlock advanced shipping logic for mixed carts and multiple products:

  • Automatically resolve shipping conflicts
  • Give customers more flexibility
  • Or fully control the outcome yourself

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/woocommerce-shipping-gateway-per-product directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to WooCommerce settings to configure shipping gateways for individual products.
sections.faq:
Can I assign multiple shipping gateways to a product?

Yes, you can select multiple shipping gateways for each product based on your preferences.

Is this plugin compatible with WooCommerce subscriptions?

Yes, this plugin works seamlessly with WooCommerce subscriptions and other extensions.

How do I restrict certain shipping gateways?

Navigate to the product editing screen and configure the restricted shipping gateways under the “Shipping Options” tab.
